feature: Add Task Priority and Queueing to TaskManager
description: Extend TaskManager to support task priorities (high/normal/low) and a proper queue system. High-priority tasks will be executed before normal/low priority tasks when resources are available.

phases.name: Core Priority System
phases.description: Add priority enum and update Task model to support priorities

subtasks.title: Add TaskPriority enum to task.py
subtasks.description: Create TaskPriority enum with HIGH=1, NORMAL=2, LOW=3 values (lower number = higher priority for heap ordering). The numeric values enable natural priority queue ordering.
subtasks.notes: Added TaskPriority enum with HIGH=1, NORMAL=2, LOW=3 values. Lower numeric values indicate higher priority for heap ordering. Committed in 94fc761.

subtasks.title: Add QUEUED status to TaskStatus enum
subtasks.description: Add TaskStatus.QUEUED for tasks waiting in the priority queue. Update display_status to handle QUEUED status.
subtasks.notes: Added TaskStatus.QUEUED enum value with "queued" string value. Updated display_status property to return "⏳ queued" for QUEUED status. Committed in 61c6cce.

subtasks.title: Update Task dataclass with priority field
subtasks.description: Add priority field to the Task base class with default value of TaskPriority.NORMAL. Update display_status to optionally show priority indicator.
subtasks.notes: Added priority field to Task dataclass with default TaskPriority.NORMAL. Added priority_indicator property returning [H]/[L] for HIGH/LOW priorities. Added get_display_status(show_priority) method for optional priority display while maintaining backward compatibility with display_status property. Committed in ba9242c.

subtasks.title: Update BackgroundShellTask and BackgroundAgentTask
subtasks.description: Ensure both task types inherit the priority field properly and can be created with a priority parameter.
subtasks.notes: Both BackgroundShellTask and BackgroundAgentTask inherit the priority field automatically via Python dataclass inheritance. No code changes needed - the priority field from Task (added in 1.3) is inherited by child dataclasses and can be passed as constructor parameter: BackgroundShellTask(command="...", priority=TaskPriority.HIGH). Default is TaskPriority.NORMAL.

phases.name: Priority Queue Implementation
phases.description: Implement thread-safe priority queue for task queueing

subtasks.title: Create PriorityTaskQueue class in manager.py
subtasks.description: Implement a thread-safe priority queue using Python's heapq and threading.Lock. Queue entries should be tuples of (priority_value, creation_time, task_id, task) to ensure stable ordering (tasks with same priority are ordered by creation time).
subtasks.notes: Implemented PriorityTaskQueue class in manager.py with thread-safe operations using heapq and threading.Lock. Queue entries are tuples of (priority_value, creation_time, task_id, task) ensuring stable ordering - high priority first, FIFO for same priority. Methods: push(), pop(), peek(), remove(), clear(), get_all(), is_empty(), __len__(), __bool__(). Committed in 2001f0d.

subtasks.title: Add queue processing logic to TaskManager
subtasks.description: Add a pending queue (_pending_queue: PriorityTaskQueue), a method to check available slots (_available_slots), and a method to process the queue (_process_queue) that starts queued tasks when slots are available.
subtasks.notes: Added _pending_queue (PriorityTaskQueue), _available_slots() method to check running task count vs MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS, and _process_queue() method to dequeue and start highest-priority tasks when slots are available. Committed in eecef89.

subtasks.title: Update _submit_task to use queue
subtasks.description: Modify _submit_task to: 1) Add task to pending queue with QUEUED status instead of immediately starting, 2) Call _process_queue to start tasks if slots available.
subtasks.notes: Modified _submit_task to: 1) Set task status to QUEUED, 2) Add task to _pending_queue via push(), 3) Call _process_queue() to start tasks if slots available. Tasks now flow through the priority queue system before being started. Committed in 91c6760.

subtasks.title: Update _notify_completion to trigger queue processing
subtasks.description: When a task completes, call _process_queue to start the next highest-priority queued task if slots are available.

phases.name: API Updates
phases.description: Update public APIs to accept priority parameter

subtasks.title: Update run_shell() and run_agent() method signatures
subtasks.description: Add optional priority parameter to run_shell() and run_agent() methods. Default to TaskPriority.NORMAL. Pass priority to task constructors.

subtasks.title: Add query methods for priority and queue
subtasks.description: Add get_queued_tasks(), get_tasks_by_priority(), and queued_count() methods to TaskManager. Update get_active_tasks to include QUEUED status.

subtasks.title: Update run_background_shell and run_background_agent tools
subtasks.description: Add optional priority parameter to both LangChain tools. Accept string values 'high', 'normal', 'low' and convert to TaskPriority enum.

subtasks.title: Update list_background_tasks to show priority
subtasks.description: Include priority column in the task listing output so users can see task priorities.

phases.name: UI Updates
phases.description: Update Rich panel to display priority and queued tasks

subtasks.title: Add QUEUED status styling and priority display
subtasks.description: Add color/style for QUEUED status in _get_status_style(). Add priority indicator to task row display (e.g., [H] for high, [L] for low).

subtasks.title: Update panel sections to show queued tasks
subtasks.description: Update _static_panel and _render_task_list to show a 'Queued' section for pending tasks in the priority queue. Update format_tasks_summary to include queued count.

phases.name: Exports and Documentation
phases.description: Update module exports and add inline documentation

subtasks.title: Update __init__.py exports
subtasks.description: Export TaskPriority from the tasks module __init__.py so it can be imported as 'from kai_code.tasks import TaskPriority'. Update module docstring with priority usage examples.

phases.name: Testing
phases.description: Add comprehensive tests for priority and queueing functionality

subtasks.title: Add tests for TaskPriority and Task priority field
subtasks.description: Test that TaskPriority enum has correct values and ordering. Test that tasks can be created with different priorities and default is NORMAL.

subtasks.title: Add tests for PriorityTaskQueue and queue processing
subtasks.description: Test queue ordering: high priority tasks should be dequeued before normal, which should be before low. Test same-priority ordering by creation time. Test that tasks are queued when MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS is reached.

subtasks.title: Add tests for priority in tools and query methods
subtasks.description: Test run_background_shell and run_background_agent tools with priority parameter. Test get_queued_tasks(), get_tasks_by_priority(), and queued_count() methods.

subtasks.title: Run full test suite and fix regressions
subtasks.description: Run pytest to ensure all existing tests pass and new tests pass. Fix any regressions introduced by the changes.

final_acceptance: High-priority tasks execute before lower-priority tasks
UI displays priority and queued tasks correctly
